idea-plugin.name: TraceLens
idea-plugin.description:
A fast, offline-first log viewer for IntelliJ IDEA.
Open .log and .out files in the ANSI-aware TraceLens editor, or load .txt files in the dedicated tool window. Includes level filtering, full-text and regex search. No network required.
See SPEC.md and ROADMAP.md for the planned feature set.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.6 — Increase BuildNumber IDE

  • Build number increased to maxinimum version to support IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.3.

1.0.5 — Navigation Thread-Safety Fix

  • Stack-frame navigation now performs its source lookup inside an application read action for thread safety

1.0.4 — Deprecated API Cleanup

  • Removed usages of deprecated IntelliJ Platform APIs for better forward compatibility
  • File chooser dialogs now use a compatibility layer that works across supported IDE versions
  • Stack-frame navigation retrieves its data context asynchronously

1.0.3 — Error Reporting and Build Updates

  • Errors can now be reported to the JetBrains Marketplace directly from the IDE
  • Updated Gradle wrapper to 8.14.5

1.0.2 — Navigation and Compatibility Fixes

  • Stack-frame navigation now shows a popup chooser when a frame matches several sources
  • Safer shutdown: background operations are guarded against project disposal
  • Improved file chooser compatibility across supported IntelliJ versions
  • Built against IntelliJ Platform 2025.2.1

1.0.1 — Responsive Layout Fix

  • Fixed responsive resizing of the TraceLens windows: the log list and details panel now resize dynamically
  • Details panel can be shown or hidden with a toggle, and the tool window toolbar is collapsible
  • Added a reset-layout action to restore the default window layout

1.0.0 — Stable Release

  • Stable Parser API (versioned with @StableApi/@ExperimentalApi/@DeprecatedApi annotations)
  • Reliable large-file support (bounded paging, retention limits, rotation detection)
  • Stack-trace navigation with clickable frames
  • Search and advanced filtering (logger, thread, date range, exclusions)
  • Tail mode with pause/resume, auto-scroll, new-entry indicator
  • Spring Boot, Logback, Log4j, JSON Lines, compact timestamp-level parsers
  • Trace grouping, timeline view, log statistics
  • Docker, Docker Compose, and local process log sources
  • Optional local AI (Ollama, OpenAI-compatible) for error analysis
  • 147 tests passing
  • Verified compatibility with IntelliJ 2024.3–2025.2 (Plugin Verifier)
